newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: C-C Amatil names Australia general manager.
newsitem.headline: C-C Amatil names Australia general manager.

text.p: Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd said on Monday that it had appointed Andrew Reeves to the new position of general manager, Australia.

Reeves is currently managing director of The Smith's Snack Food Co, a subsidiary of United Biscuits Plc, and was formerly sales and marketing director of C-C Amatil's snack foods division before it was sold to Smith's in 1993.

"The role of general manager, Australia, will be a pivotal one as we refocus our business to take account of our changing customers' needs and as we continue to grow our business in the interest of shareholders," C-C Amatil said.
Each of C-C Amatil's state managers would report to Reeves.

"Further announcements will be made in due course concerning important structural changes and further personnel moves designed to enhance our system's ability to drive profitable volume growth in Australasia," C-C Amatil said.
C-C Amatil is about 33 percent owned by The Coca-Cola Co.
